title: Well-posedness and longtime behavior of the conserved Navier--Stokes--Allen--Cahn equations with unmatched viscosities and singular potential
summary: We consider an incompressible Navier--Stokes system nonlinearly coupled with a conserved Allen--Cahn equation with a singular potential (e.g., of Flory--Huggins type). This model describes a mass-conserving two-phase flow with constant density and non-constant viscosity. First, in three spatial dimensions, we prove the existence and uniqueness of local-in-time strong solutions to the associated initial--boundary value problem, subject to no-slip boundary conditions for the velocity field and homogeneous boundary conditions for the phase field.
